basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Peon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Four Peon (Jawan) posts in the courts of Kalaburagi district, in the Kalyana Karnataka residual cadre, are being filled by direct recruitment by the Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸತ್ರ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಧೀಶರ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ, ಕಲಬುರಗಿ). The pay scale is Rs. 27000-650-29600-725-32500-800-35700-900-39300-1000-43300-1125-46675 with other allowances, and candidates need an SSLC pass and the ability to read and write Kannada. Applications are accepted only online at kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026 (till 1

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the link on the court website by online payment through net banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI. The last date for fee payment is 17 December 2026, within State Bank of India branch transaction hours; if that day is a holiday, the next bank working day is the last date. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

how_to_apply: Open the link given on the court website kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026 (11.59 PM).
Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and an e-mail ID if you have one; the office is not responsible if an SMS or e-mail does not reach you.
Upload a recent colour photograph, 5 cm high x 3.6 cm wide, 50 KB, in jpg format, with a light (preferably white) background.
Upload your signature made in black ballpoint pen on white paper, 2.5 cm high x 7.5 cm wide, 2 KB, in jpg format; do not sign on the photograph.
Fill in all details asked, enter the reservations you claim, and pay the fee as shown in the application.
Download the application and keep it with the SBI E-pay receipt until the recruitment process is over.
Press the upload documents button, upload the documents, then use the Re-print option to print the final copy of the application and keep it.
Only one application may be submitted.
important_instructions: Incorrect applications will be rejected. Certificates obtained after the last date or in other formats will not be considered, and the reservation or candidature will be disqualified. Impersonation, forged or tampered documents, false statements, hiding facts or unfair means will lead to cancellation of candidature, criminal proceedings and disciplinary action. Merely applying online and qualifying gives no right to appointment; appointment is subject to eligibility criteria fixed by the Government from time to time. Candidates cannot correspond with the office about this recruitment. For more information, the office telephone number is 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM).

content_sections.heading: About Kalaburagi District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi, and signed by G.L. Lakshminarayana, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi. The four Peon posts are vacancies in the courts of Kalaburagi district under the Kalyana Karnataka residual cadre, and recruitment is made under the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Ministerial and Other Posts) (Recruitment) Rules, 1982 and the amendment rules of 2007 and 2021.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 04 Peon (Jawan) posts with the following reservation break-up. As per Government Order No. CASUE 02 SEHIMA 2026 dated 13.05.2026, reservation has been kept separately for Scheduled Caste categories A, B and C. If eligible candidates are not available for the women reservation, those posts will be filled by other candidates of the respective categories (G.O No. DPAR 34 Seneni 95, Bengaluru dated 15th July, 1996).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Must have passed the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, Government of Karnataka, or hold an equivalent qualification, on the last date fixed for filling applications. Must be able to read and write Kannada. Candidates whose 10th marks are in grades must have them converted into marks by the head of the concerned school and enter the total percentage correctly out of 100 in the application; applications with discrepancies will be rejected. Candidates are directed to the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. Age is counted as on the last date fixed for receiving applications. The candidate must have completed 18 years and must not exceed the maximum age below. *Under Government Order No. CASUE 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, a one-time 5-year relaxation in the maximum age has been given to candidates of all categories in selection processes under direct recruitment notifications issued from the date of that order up to 31.12.2027.

rows.category: Holding or held a post in the Karnataka State Government, a local authority, or a corporation set up under a State or Central Act and owned or controlled by the Karnataka Government
rows.relaxation: Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less
Years of service in the armed forces plus 3 years

rows.category: Persons with disabilities, widows and bonded labourers
Holding a post in the Census Department of the Government of India in Karnataka
rows.relaxation: Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less

rows.category: Released after serving as a full-time cadet instructor in the National Cadet Corps
Working or worked as a village group supervisor appointed under a State Government sponsored rural employment scheme

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Peon post carries the pay scale 27000-650-29600-725-32500-800-35700-900-39300-1000-43300-1125-46675 and other allowances. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years under the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977. Candidates already in government service must follow Rule 11 of the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, as amended.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the link on the court website by online payment through net banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI. Challan, demand draft, postal order or money order is not accepted, and applications without the fee will be rejected. The last date for fee payment is 17 December 2026, within State Bank of India branch transaction hours; if that day is a holiday, the next bank working day is the last date. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kalaburagi District Court Peon
content_sections.text: Open the link given on the court website kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026 (11.59 PM). Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and an e-mail ID if you have one; the office is not responsible if an SMS or e-mail does not reach you. Upload a recent colour photograph, 5 cm high x 3.6 cm wide, 50 KB, in jpg format, with a light (preferably white) background. Upload your signature made in black ballpoint pen on white paper, 2.5 cm high x 7.5 cm wide, 2 KB, in jpg format; do not sign on the photograph. Fill in all details asked, enter the reservations you claim, and pay the fee as shown in the application. Download the application and keep it with the SBI E-pay receipt until the recruitment process is over. Press the upload documents button, upload the documents, then use the Re-print option to print the final copy of the application and keep it. Only one application may be submitted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certificates must be obtained in the prescribed formats from the competent authority before the last date; originals must be produced at verification. Copy of the SBI e-pay receipt for the fee paid SSLC marks card / transfer certificate / cumulative record as proof of date of birth Caste certificate for SC (Category-A, B, C), ST, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A or 3B in the prescribed form, if reservation is claimed Rural reservation certificate in Form-1 and Form-2; SC/ST/Category-1/2A/2B/3A/3B candidates claiming rural reservation submit Form-2 only Discharge certificate for ex-servicemen; certificate from the competent authority for widows and bonded labourers claiming age relaxation; disability certificate if claimed for age relaxation Two character certificates from respectable persons issued within 6 months of the last date, and a school conduct certificate No Objection Certificate (candidates in government service follow Rule 11 of the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio 1:10 (10 candidates per post) on the basis of the overall percentage of marks in the qualifying examination, according to the posts announced. Selection will be made on the marks obtained in the interview, which carries 10 marks. Eligible candidates will be informed by SMS and e-mail, and the list of candidates eligible for interview will be published on the court website; candidates must download this list and produce it when they attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incorrect applications will be rejected. Certificates obtained after the last date or in other formats will not be considered, and the reservation or candidature will be disqualified. Impersonation, forged or tampered documents, false statements, hiding facts or unfair means will lead to cancellation of candidature, criminal proceedings and disciplinary action. Merely applying online and qualifying gives no right to appointment; appointment is subject to eligibility criteria fixed by the Government from time to time. Candidates cannot correspond with the office about this recruitment. For more information, the office telephone number is 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM).

faq.question: Q1. How many Peon vacancies are in Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 04 Peon (Jawan) posts: 2 General Merit (1 women, 1 rural), 1 Category-1 and 1 Category-2A.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Kalaburagi District Court Peon posts?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 15 December 2026 at 11.59 PM, and the fee can be paid until 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Kalaburagi District Court Peon post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board or an equivalent qualification, and must be able to read and write Kannada.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Kalaburagi District Court Peon post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years; the maximum is 35+5 years for General, 38+5 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B and 40+5 years for SC/ST/Category-1, as on the last date for applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Kalaburagi District Court Peon?
Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200/- for General and Rs. 100/- for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B; SC, ST, Category-1 and persons with disabilities are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Kalaburagi District Court Peon post?
faq.answer: Apply only online through the link on kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/, uploading your photo, signature and documents and paying the fee online.

faq.question: Q8. How will Peons be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio 1:10 on their overall percentage in the qualifying examination and selected on the marks of a 10-mark interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a probation period?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years under the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if 10th marks are given in grades?
faq.answer: The grades must be converted into marks by the school head, and the total percentage entered correctly out of 100; applications with discrepancies will be rejected.
